source: If x18n finds the wrong files, or none, run {0}. It shows the detected presets, the resources that each locale finder found, and the source files that each scanner read.
text: Se x18n trova i file sbagliati, o nessuno, esegui {0}. Mostra i preset rilevati, le risorse trovate da ciascun finder delle lingue e i file sorgente letti da ciascuno scanner.
